import numpy as np

img = np.arange(25, dtype=float).reshape(5, 5)
kernel = np.array([[1, 0, -1],
                   [1, 0, -1],
                   [1, 0, -1]], dtype=float)           # bộ phát hiện cạnh dọc

def conv2d(image, k):
    kh, kw = k.shape
    H, W = image.shape
    out = np.zeros((H - kh + 1, W - kw + 1))
    for i in range(out.shape[0]):
        for j in range(out.shape[1]):
            out[i, j] = np.sum(image[i:i + kh, j:j + kw] * k)   # trượt và nhân-cộng
    return out

print(conv2d(img, kernel))

def max_pool(x, size=2):
    H, W = x.shape
    return x.reshape(H // size, size, W // size, size).max(axis=(1, 3))

print(max_pool(np.arange(16.0).reshape(4, 4)))

import numpy as np

img = np.arange(25, dtype=float).reshape(5, 5)
kernel = np.array([[1, 0, -1], [1, 0, -1], [1, 0, -1]], dtype=float)

def conv2d(image, k):
    kh, kw = k.shape
    H, W = image.shape
    out = np.zeros((H - kh + 1, W - kw + 1))
    for i in range(out.shape[0]):
        for j in range(out.shape[1]):
            out[i, j] = np.sum(image[i:i + kh, j:j + kw] * k)
    return out

out = conv2d(img, kernel)
print(out)
